title: Great for aesthetic’s or guest bed…
text:
Great for aesthetic’s or guest bed…. These pillows provide ample amount of fluff- they’re aesthetically pleasing while adding plenty of fill to make your bed look inviting + appealing!! Sent vacuum sealed these open up when freed of wrapping and take their full shape within a few hours..

Pillows are filled with a synthetic down. They are comfortable to rest and relax on sleeping at any angle.. front, side, back sleepers- I don’t find it makes a difference! Stitching and finish work feels secure, I had no loose threads and both pillow + casing show nice finish detail.

My complaint is in the ability to maintain fluff (loft!) while using long term.. If slept on all night- these don’t seem to hold enough exterior support or density in the fill to keep up their shape night after night.. I noticed after a few days of using the pillows have begun to crush in a bit. Having said that.. they are great as fillers for presenting a bed that looks inviting and shows off a wow factor, they’re capable of being a “nap” pillow if used in shorter sleep increments as well. I personally chose to use in my guest bedroom..!! As we most often host guest for only a night or two so using in this capacity will allow these to provide comfort and density without the daily wear/tear of crushing the filler under constant use.

Add a price point of $22 for a set of two- they are actually more on par for a filler pillow insert. The difference between these allow user the option to use on a daily basis bc of finished fabric/material vs. standard baton filler pillows. Everything is dependent on one’s preference and style of pillow options. Hoping this info can help make your decision.. stay safe everyone!
